One Battle After Another Front RowFeaturing the stars of the filmListen on the AppListen on the App “One Battle After Another” has received 13 Oscar nominations, including Best Picture, Best Director, Best Adapted Screenplay, and four acting nominations (for del Toro, DiCaprio, Penn, and Taylor), the second-most of any film at the Academy Awards on March 15. During the special, Leonardo DiCaprio discussed working with non-actors while shooting the film, Teyana Taylor reflects on postpartum depression and her role as Perfidia Beverly Hills, and more. Stream the full “One Battle After Another Front Row” special on the SiriusXM app now. Radio Andy Radio Andy is Andy Cohen’s universe, spanning pop culture, music, news, and so much more. Hear unbelievable moments play out live on air, plus news-making interviews, and unfiltered points of view. We can promise you that Radio Andy is always entertaining and always unpredictable. Learn more about Radio Andy on SiriusXM.
